description: This Java class, LogWrapper, implements the LogNode interface and wraps Android's native Log utility. It is designed to intercept log messages, optionally add stack trace information for exceptions, and pass log data along a chain of LogNode instances, enabling flexible logging configurations within an Android application.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native logging mechanism to allow chaining of log nodes and additional processing of log messages.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain to which log data will be passed after this node processes it.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Logs a message with a given priority and tag. If an exception is provided, its stack trace is appended. Passes the log message to the next node in the chain if available.
